intro: Across 26 articles spanning 12 April 2026 to 9 September 2026, ZCyberNews tracked Windows vulnerabilities exploited by Kyber, Chaotic Eclipse, and Toy Ghouls. Five CVEs recurred: CVE-2024-1708 at CVSS 8.4, alongside CVE-2026-33104, CVE-2026-8069, CVE-2026-81963, and CVE-2026-85880, each rated 7.8. The severity mix comprised three critical, nineteen high, and four medium issues. Government, consumer electronics, financial services, gaming, and healthcare ranked among the most affected sectors, while impact touched Global, North america, and Russian federation.
